content:
As the Liquid Glass redesign continues rolling out to most iOS WhatsApp users, the messaging platform is now testing another visual tweak, this time focused on the appearance of conversation bubbles. Here's what we know so far.

A fresher, rounder look for chat bubbles

Months after WhatsApp finally rolled out its Liquid Glass redesign more broadly — following months of testing and refinement with select user groups through TestFlight.

Around the same time, WABetaInfo spotted signs of a WhatsApp conversation bubble redesign in the app's code. According to the site's latest report, the new bubble design has now begun rolling out to some users via the latest TestFlight build.

The following is quoted from WABetaInfo's report:

Beyond the change in message bubble shape, the new design also adjusts how media and links appear in chats. WhatsApp has removed the green borders around media and links, giving photos, videos, animated GIFs, and link previews a cleaner, more uniform look.

According to WABetaInfo, the new design is currently only available to a small number of WhatsApp TestFlight users, and a timeline for a broader rollout to all iOS users has not yet been confirmed.
